shared_elements: human figure rendered in the round
incised linear surface markings resembling script or striated patterning
justification: Both depict a frontal, symmetrical human figure carved in the round with associated incised linear signs on adjoining flat surfaces, which is a moderately specific correspondence in the sculptural conventions used. However, A shows only a head with a striated headdress and modelled facial features, while B shows a standing body against a back-pillar on a stepped base, so almost none of the depicted parts, attributes or relationships actually overlap.
